companyDescription: AI Memory · HBM4/HBM3E leader with capacity sold out through 2026-2028 — the picks-and-shovels memory play riding (and getting whipsawed by) the AI capex cycle
priceNote: Trading $892.67 (+7.62%), rebounding off an early-Aug low near $829 after MU's worst month in over a decade — down ~13% from the Jul 10 level of $1,021.28 and ~29% off the $1,255 all-time high on AI-capex-sustainability fears, before today's relief rally.
summary: Micron shares round-tripped hard since the Jul 10 report — down ~29% from the $1,255 all-time high and ~13% from the prior $1,021.28 level as AI-capex-sustainability fears drove MU's worst month in over a decade, before a +7.62% relief rally today on Bank of America's 'no real change in fundamentals' call. Consensus targets now cluster around $1,270-$1,508 (38-46 analysts, Strong Buy), implying roughly 42-69% upside from $892.67, while HBM capacity remains sold out through 2026-2028 and Q4 FY26 earnings (est. ~Sep 22, 2026) is the first hard data point since the correction began. The pullback widens the discount to consensus versus the Jul 10 report, but a hawkish Fed (3-way FOMC dissent favoring a hike) and rising Chinese (CXMT) memory competition keep this a scale-in, not an all-in.

catalysts.name: Q4 FY2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: First hard data point since the July AI-capex-fear selloff — tests whether the ~$50B+ FQ4 revenue trajectory and HBM4 volume ramp held through the correction, and whether the sold-out capacity narrative into fiscal 2027 is intact.

catalysts.name: HBM4 Volume Ramp for NVIDIA Vera Rubin
catalysts.description: Micron continues volume shipment of HBM4 12-Hi for NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform — directly tied to NVDA's H2 2026 shipment timeline, with HBM4E volume production still targeted for calendar 2027.

catalysts.name: Potential US Tariffs on Chinese Memory Chips
catalysts.description: Reports of possible US tariffs targeting Chinese memory imports (aimed at CXMT) could tighten non-Micron supply and reinforce MU's pricing power just as the market digests China capacity-expansion fears — no confirmed timeline yet.

risks: AI-capex-sustainability fears triggered MU's worst month in over a decade in July 2026 — even after today's rebound, the stock is still ~29% off its $1,255 all-time high, showing how fast sentiment can swing with no fundamental change at the company.
CXMT (China) is aggressively expanding memory capacity — a structural supply-side risk to Micron's pricing power, partially offset by reported potential US tariffs on Chinese memory imports.

Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026 (9-3 vote) but three members (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) dissented in favor of a hike — a more hawkish signal than the June meeting, pressuring long-duration AI-capex multiples independent of MU's own execution.

Memory remains the most historically cyclical semis sub-sector; the HBM supercycle thesis still assumes AI capex sustains through 2027-2028, a view some analysts continue to question even with MU's forward P/E near 5x looking historically cheap.

Next confirmed hard data point (Q4 FY26 earnings, est. ~Sep 22) is roughly 7 weeks out and lands right after the Sep 15-16 FOMC — plenty of runway for the AI-capex narrative to swing again before either event.

Next FOMC is Sep 15-16, 2026, one week before MU's expected earnings.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Inflation remains above the 2% target; the Fed cited it as 'elevated' with supply-side (energy) pressure, removing any near-term rate-cut tailwind for high-multiple AI names.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: AI/semis names are the most rate-sensitive part of the market; the Jul 2026 sector-wide selloff — MU's worst month in over a decade — shows how quickly capex-sustainability fears plus a hawkish Fed can compress long-duration multiples with no company-specific miss involved.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — no imminent hike, but three FOMC dissents now favor one, and the Sep 15-16 meeting lands right before MU's earnings. A hawkish surprise there would compound both AI-capex-fear sentiment and memory's structurally higher cyclicality.

risks: ความกังวลเรื่องความยั่งยืนของ AI capex ทำให้เดือน ก.ค. 2026 เป็นเดือนที่แย่ที่สุดของ MU ในรอบกว่าทศวรรษ — แม้จะรีบาวด์วันนี้ หุ้นยังต่ำกว่า all-time high $1,255 อยู่ ~29% สะท้อนว่า sentiment เหวี่ยงเร็วมากโดยที่ fundamentals ของบริษัทไม่เปลี่ยน
CXMT (จีน) กำลังขยายกำลังผลิตหน่วยความจำอย่างรวดเร็ว — ความเสี่ยงเชิงโครงสร้างต่อ pricing power ของ Micron แม้จะมีข่าวมาตรการภาษีสหรัฐฯ มาช่วย offset บางส่วน
Fed คงดอกเบี้ย 3.50-3.75% เมื่อ 29 ก.ค. 2026 (โหวต 9-3) แต่มี 3 เสียง (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) dissent อยากขึ้นดอกเบี้ย — hawkish กว่าการประชุมเดือน มิ.ย. กดดัน multiple ของหุ้น AI duration ยาว

หน่วยความจำยังเป็น sub-sector ที่ cyclical ที่สุดใน semis ในอดีต — thesis HBM supercycle ยังต้องพึ่ง AI capex ที่ยั่งยืนถึงปี 2027-2028 ซึ่งบาง analyst ยังตั้งคำถาม แม้ forward P/E ของ MU จะอยู่ที่ราว 5 เท่าซึ่งถูกมากเทียบในอดีต
hard data point ถัดไป (earnings Q4 FY26 ประมาณ 22 ก.ย.) ยังอีกราว 7 สัปดาห์ และอยู่หลัง FOMC 15-16 ก.ย. พอดี — มีเวลาเหลือให้ narrative AI capex เหวี่ยงได้อีกก่อนถึงทั้งสอง event
